# NEW 2026-11-21 v9.5 Module 1: Imperial Governance Automation Console (oe_auto_, Slot 68). Generated by gen_empire_automation.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# Strictly human-only (is_ai = no) triggers for Imperial Governance Automation Console (Slot 68).

# Country scope. Every automation entry point requires a human, non-rebel player country.
oe_auto_human_ok = {
    is_ai = no
    is_rebel_country = no
}

# Location scope. Town, City, or Megalopolis.
oe_auto_is_urban_rank = {
    OR = {
        location_rank = location_rank:town
        location_rank = location_rank:city
        location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
    }
}

# Location scope. City or Megalopolis (for academies/universities).
oe_auto_is_city_rank = {
    OR = {
        location_rank = location_rank:city
        location_rank = location_rank:megalopolis
    }
}

# Country scope. Has unlocked at least one road construction advance.
oe_auto_has_any_road_tech = {
    OR = {
        has_advance = railroad_advance
        has_advance = modern_road_advance
        has_advance = paved_road_advance
        has_advance = road_building
    }
}

# Country scope. Re-checked before EVERY single automated construction: never borrows, never exceeds floor or cap.
oe_auto_infra_has_budget = {
    is_ai = no
    num_loans = 0
    gold >= oe_auto_treasury_floor_value
    oe_auto_rd_yr_total < oe_auto_annual_cap_value
}

# Country scope. Engine 1 entry readiness (peace by default unless player allows wartime infra).
oe_auto_infra_ready = {
    oe_auto_human_ok = yes
    num_loans = 0
    gold >= oe_auto_treasury_floor_value
    OR = {
        at_war = no
        var:oe_auto_war_infra_ok ?= 1
    }
}

# Subject country scope. Theme, Roman Exarchate, or Far Seas Overseas Exarchate managed by Engine 2.
oe_auto_is_managed_prefect_subject = {
    OR = {
        oe_theme_member_trigger = yes
        has_variable = oe_ar_exarchate
        is_subject_type = oe_far_exarchate
    }
}

# Subject country scope. Eligible for Engine 2 annual replenishment subsidy.
oe_auto_subject_needs_subsidy = {
    oe_auto_is_managed_prefect_subject = yes
    NOT = { has_country_modifier = oe_auto_mod_theme_subsidy }
    OR = {
        gold < 80
        num_loans > 0
        var:oe_tq_last ?= 3
    }
}

# Subject country scope. Low-loyalty or high-liberty-desire warning state.
oe_auto_subject_is_distressed = {
    OR = {
        liberty_desire >= 45
        subject_loyalty < 50
        AND = {
            has_variable = oe_theme_loyalty_band
            var:oe_theme_loyalty_band <= 1
        }
    }
}

# Country scope. Native parliament is off cooldown and idle for 6+ months (vanilla cooldown = 60 months).
oe_auto_parl_idle_trigger = {
    has_parliament = yes
    is_active_parliament = no
    months_since_last_parliament_called >= 66
}
